description: Send and receive 868 MHz home-automation radio protocols (the Domino and IoHome protocol families: blinds, windows, lights, switches) with an ADALM-PLUTO software-defined radio. Pure managed code, async-first, runs on Linux arm64.
Command-line tool for OpenHomeRadio: send, receive, capture and decode 868 MHz home-automation radio protocols (the Domino and IoHome protocol families) with an ADALM-PLUTO software-defined radio.
Kerf.Kernel foundation, derived from Open CASCADE Technology 8.0.1 (Open Cascade SAS), ported to C# and redesigned: a port of OCCT's Standard, Precision and maths packages (gp, ...).

Kerf.Kernel modelling data, derived from Open CASCADE Technology 8.0.1 (Open Cascade SAS), ported to C# and redesigned: a port of OCCT's TKG2d, TKG3d, TKGeomBase and TKBRep (curves, surfaces, adaptors, topology).

Kerf.Kernel modelling algorithms, derived from Open CASCADE Technology 8.0.1 (Open Cascade SAS), ported to C# and redesigned: a port of OCCT's TKGeomAlgo, TKTopAlgo and TKPrim (intersections, classification, topological algorithms, primitives).

Kerf.Kernel data exchange, derived from Open CASCADE Technology 8.0.1 (Open Cascade SAS), ported to C# and redesigned: a port of OCCT's TKXSBase, TKDESTEP and TKDESTL (the exchange framework, STEP, STL), with an immutable assembly tree in place of XCAF.
Kerf.Modeling: a code-first CAD modelling library for .NET, derived from build123d (the build123d contributors), over Kerf.Kernel.
